data.name: Fabrienne
data.long_meaning: In Latin, Fabrienne means 'Dweller at the fabric'. This name is derived from the Roman family name Fabius, which is believed to have originated from the Latin word faber, meaning 'worker' or 'maker'. Fabrienne may have been given to a girl whose family was involved in textile production or was known for her creativity and craftsmanship.
